headline: Rachika Nayar’s Heaven Come Crashing is an instrumental epic of desperate longing
summary: Rachika Nayar's new album "Heaven Come Crashing" features a surprising shift to drum and bass. This marks a significant departure from her previous percussion-less debut record. The album is described as an instrumental epic conveying desperate longing.

headline: Fender’s CEO seems to think your bandmates are just analog AI
summary: Fender CEO Edward "Bud" Cole made controversial comments comparing bandmates to "analog AI." The remarks, made in May, are now causing a stir and adding to Fender's PR issues. Cole's statements were part of an interview celebrating the Telecaster's 75th anniversary.

headline: Xbox prices are increasing by up to €200 or £170
summary: Microsoft announced significant price hikes for Xbox consoles in the EU and UK. Prices will increase by up to €200 or £170, depending on the model. The 1TB Xbox Series X with a disc drive is particularly affected by these changes.

headline: Skylight’s smart calendars are up to $90 off during its back-to-school sale
summary: Skylight is offering discounts of up to $90 on its smart calendars. The back-to-school sale aims to help families manage hectic schedules. The promotion runs from August 2nd through August 9th, providing a limited-time deal.

headline: Wonder Man Showrunner Confirms 'Contracts Were Signed, Schedules Were Cleared' Before Marvel Canceled Season 2
summary: Wonder Man showrunner Andrew Guest spoke out about the abrupt cancellation of Season 2. He confirmed that contracts were signed and schedules were cleared for the season. The show's demise came unexpectedly after preparations were already underway.

headline: Wicked Star Ariana Grande to Take a 'Step Back From Visibility' Amid 'Endless, Ongoing Public Scrutiny'
summary: Ariana Grande announced she will step back from public visibility after her Eternal Sunshine tour. The decision comes amid "endless, ongoing public scrutiny" she has faced. Grande has also exited the West End musical "Sunday in the Park with George."

headline: Tom Holland Says Spider-Man 5 Is 'Unclear,' Teases He Knows When Miles Morales Will Join the MCU
summary: Tom Holland states that the status of "Spider-Man 5" is currently "unclear." However, he teased that he knows when Miles Morales will join the MCU. Fans await further details on Peter Parker's future and the introduction of Miles Morales.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Comes Close to Passing Avengers: Endgame With Second Biggest Box Office Debut of All Time at $927 Million Globally
summary: "Spider-Man: Brand New Day" achieved a massive $927 million global box office debut. This makes it the second-biggest opening of all time, almost surpassing "Avengers: Endgame." The film combined Tom Holland's appeal and the MCU's power for its success.

headline: Trump suggests new talks with Iran to begin on Monday
summary: Donald Trump has proposed new talks with Iran, potentially starting on Monday. Tehran has not yet responded to the suggestion for these imminent discussions. Previous claims by Trump of a nearing peace deal have been followed by renewed conflict.

headline: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
summary: Two crew members died in Greece after firefighting helicopters collided. One Danish and one Greek national were killed in the incident. A British pilot and another Greek crew member managed to survive the crash.

headline: Ariana Grande to take a break from public life amid 'endless' scrutiny
summary: US singer Ariana Grande will step back from public visibility after her world tour. Her representative stated the decision is due to "endless, ongoing public scrutiny." The 33-year-old artist plans to retreat from the spotlight next month.

headline: Almost £200,000 of fuel stolen from UK forecourts every day since Iran war began
summary: Approximately £200,000 worth of fuel is stolen daily from UK forecourts. Incidents of fuel theft without payment have increased by 20% in five months. This surge in thefts coincides with the beginning of the Iran war, according to analysis.
